description: Adds an AI news target: type any topic and a model (Google Gemini) writes the news for you. The target shows a short headline with a "Tap to view full" line underneath; tapping opens the full story with two buttons: close & dismiss the target, or just close.
changelog:
- First release: **AI News target** with short headline + **Tap to view full** line
- Full article screen with **Close & dismiss** and **Close** buttons
- Per-target settings: **feed URL**, **update interval** (15 min – 8 h) and **number of stories**
